text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Toronto and East York Community Council to extend the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Booth Avenue, between Queen Street East and Eastern Avenue, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., 7 days a week. By extending the overnight on-street permit parking hours, residents will have improved parking flexibility and the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, can effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Booth Avenue, between Queen Street East and Eastern Avenue from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., 7 days a week.
